lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if you could turn any website into a command-line tool?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI and dev tools are exploding — but they’re still stuck in the browser.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenCLI lets you run any web app or tool directly from your terminal.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s built with TypeScript and handles AI-native runtimes seamlessly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers, data scientists, and automation lovers — this changes your workflow.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You don’t need to switch apps — just type, like you’re using a CLI.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to see how your favorite tools could work from the terminal?
